title: 第30章 任务名称：金银领斯戈尔山脉人面狼群
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
接下来的半个月，伊森的日子过得极其规律。

    白天泡在教学区，把那些基础课程一门一门地啃过去。

    晚上回到别墅，开启修炼室的法阵，绘制新的精神符文。

    第一枚“源初之印”凝聚成功后，第二枚的难度明显增加了几分。

    精神海中那枚已经固化的符文占据着中央位置，周围那些灰色雾气围绕它缓慢旋转，形成了一种微妙的平衡。

    新符文要在不扰动这个平衡的前提下，在边缘处找到自己的位置。

    伊森花了三天时间，才成功凝聚出第二枚符文。

    那枚符文比第一枚小了一圈，悬浮在精神海边缘，散发着稍暗一些的灰白色光芒。

    两枚符文之间隐隐有一种联系，像两颗相互绕转的星辰，让整个精神海比之前稳定、扩大了不少。

    第14天上午伊森坐在修炼室中央，看着面前魔石，沉默了很久。

    只剩下三枚魔石。

    “得找点事做了。”

    他推门走出别墅，沿着石道朝后勤区走去。

    后勤区的大厅依旧热闹。

    几十个窗口前排着长短不一的队伍，有穿着深色袍服的老生，也有和他一样的新生面孔。

    墙上那块巨大的黑色石板还在滚动显示各类物资兑换价格和任务信息。

    伊森走到大厅左侧的一排石柱前。

    每根石柱约莫一人高，顶端镶嵌着一枚拳头大小的黑色水晶，水晶表面有符文流转。

    这是学院的任务查询终端，学生凭骨牌就能使用。

    他取出骨牌，按在其中一根石柱的凹槽里。

    黑色水晶表面的符文亮起，淡蓝色的光芒从水晶内部投射出来，在石柱上方形成一块约莫两尺见方的光幕。

    【血骨塔学院任务系统】

    【学生：伊森·里奥】

    【学徒等级：一等（未认证）】

    【可接任务数量：不限】

    【请在下方筛选任务条件】

    光幕上列出一排筛选选项：任务类型、任务等级、报酬范围、期限......

    伊森快速勾选了几个条件：剿灭类、学徒级、报酬十到一百魔石、期限一个月内。

    光幕闪烁了一下，刷出一长列任务清单。

    【清理灰岩矿洞穴鼠群】报酬15魔石，要求1-3人，期限10天

    【清剿黑铁森林鬃毛狼群】报酬30魔石，要求2-4人，期限15天

    【处理金银领斯戈尔山脉人面狼群】报酬20魔石，要求3-5人，期限18日
content_en:
In the next half month, Ethan's life was extremely regular.

    During the day, I spent time in the teaching area and studied the basic courses one by one.

    Return to the villa in the evening, open the magic circle in the practice room, and draw new spiritual runes.

    After the first "Seal of the Origin" was successfully condensed, the difficulty of the second one increased significantly.

    The solidified rune in the spiritual sea occupies the central position, and the surrounding gray mist slowly rotates around it, forming a delicate balance.

    New runes must find their place on the edge without disturbing this balance.

    It took Ethan three days to successfully condense the second rune.

    That rune was smaller than the first one, suspended on the edge of the spiritual sea, emitting a slightly darker gray-white light.

    There is a faint connection between the two runes, like two stars orbiting each other, which makes the entire spiritual sea much more stable and expanded than before.

    On the morning of the 14th day, Ethan sat in the middle of the training room, looking at the magic stone in front of him, and was silent for a long time.

    There are only three magic stones left.

    "Gotta find something to do."

    He opened the door and walked out of the villa, walking along the stone path towards the logistics area.

    The lobby in the logistics area is still lively.

    There were queues of varying lengths in front of dozens of windows, including old students wearing dark robes and fresh faces like him.

    The huge black slate on the wall is still scrolling to display various material exchange prices and mission information.

    Ethan walked to a row of stone pillars on the left side of the hall.

    Each stone pillar is about a person tall, with a fist-sized black crystal inlaid on the top, with runes flowing on the surface of the crystal.

    This is the college's task inquiry terminal, which students can use with dominoes.

    He took out the domino and pressed it into the groove of one of the stone pillars.

    The runes on the surface of the black crystal lit up, and light blue light was projected from the inside of the crystal, forming a light curtain about two feet square above the stone pillar.

    [Blood Bone Tower Academy Mission System]

    [Student: Ethan Leo]

    [Apprentice Level: First Class (Uncertified)]

    [Number of tasks that can be accepted: no limit]

    [Please filter the task conditions below]

    A row of filtering options is listed on the light screen: task type, task level, remuneration range, deadline...

    Ethan quickly checked a few conditions: destruction type, apprentice level, reward of ten to one hundred magic stones, and deadline within one month.

    The light screen flickered, and a long list of tasks appeared.

    [Clean up the cave rats in the limestone mine] The reward is 15 magic stones, 1-3 people are required, and the period is 10 days.

    [Suppress the Mane Wolves of the Black Iron Forest] The reward is 30 magic stones, 2-4 people are required, and the period is 15 days.

    [Dealing with the human-faced wolves in the Gold and Silver Collar Sgol Mountains] The reward is 20 magic stones, requires 3-5 people, and the deadline is 18 days
